items.finding: Capital One reports aggregate card activity and the acquired Discover portfolio; the former Walmart program had terminated and no active covered-company program amount was disclosed.
Discover reports aggregate direct credit-card and payment-network activity but no named covered-company financing program amount.
Klarna reports provider-wide GMV and payment-option mix but no covered-company program amount that can support a numerical mapping.
Block explains its BNPL mechanics and merchant-fee accounting but does not identify a covered merchant with a program-level amount.
